title: Split Pea and Slovakian Sausage Stew
description: A hearty Italian-inspired stew made with Slovakian sausage, split peas, and a hint of monsoon spice. Perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: Split peas
ingredients.notes: Rinse and sort the peas before using

ingredients.name: Monsoon spice blend
ingredients.notes: Use a store-bought or homemade blend

ingredients.name: Mustardy vinegar
ingredients.notes: Use a store-bought or homemade vinegar

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the pot and set it aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the split peas, monsoon spice blend, and mustardy vinegar to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a boil.
Return the sausage to the pot and reduce the heat to low.
Simmer the stew for 30 minutes or until the peas are tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
